BEN.note: It says ANIP issues birth acts and the NPI but states no link or exchange between the civil register and the ID system.
The late birth registration pilot is not said to use a digital register; no digital civil registration system is named.
The document names no identity law or decree.

facts.fact: ANIP's director general said citizens can now verify the authenticity of an act in under a minute through the eservices.anip.bj platform or the ANIP BJ app.
ANIP, per its director general, said 98% of Benin's population is already enrolled.

BEN.note: It states no ID number given at birth.
The document says nothing about police station records.

facts.fact: ANIP said it plans to enrol about 30,000 refugees in November 2026.

BEN.note: It names a late-birth registration pilot by witness testimony from 2 November 2026 but not digital entry at local civil offices.
